problems: Program length 6 years for entrants through 2012, 7 thereafter (terminal_pgy_by_entry_year). LL labels transfer Ramanathan by years at LL. McClure's adjudicator 'switch' rests on an NPI namesake; training_history records her as unknown. CC retries all succeeded (0 records).
event_2017: All six non-graduating residents (entrants 2013-2016) left LL in summer 2017 and each joined another program at the next PGY with no lost time: Hanna PGY4->UC Irvine PGY5, Oh PGY3->UCI PGY4, Chakravarthy PGY3->Cleveland Clinic PGY4, Krafft PGY2->USF PGY3, Jeelani PGY2->Brigham PGY3 (all 2017-18), Chan PGY1->Cedars (PGY3 2018-19; Cedars 2017-18 unobserved). Ajayi and Woods graduated June 2017. The program nav changed from '2016-2017 Residents' to '2017-2018 Resident' (singular) by Feb 2018 (CC-MAIN-2018-09/-13): the only resident was the 2017 intern Eastin. PD Alexander Zouros (PD since ~2013) was still named on the program page in Jun 2018 (CC 2018-06-23); by Aug 2018 (CC 2018-08-21) the page names chair Warren Boling as PD. No archived LLU program page, GME page or news.llu.edu item (CDX 2016-2020, keyword filter) mentions probation, closure or the departures; ACGME status history for 2017 is not archived. The coordinated same-PGY placement of all residents at five programs is the pattern of a released/closing-program situation (e.g. ACGME probation or voluntary downsizing), but the cause is NOT documented in any allowed source. Consequence: no LL graduates 2018-2022, so the alumni page (2017 then 2023) omits nobody.
